LESSON: ACTS OF COMPASSION

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Church
Topic 5.2: Acts of Compassion

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Acts of Compassion
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why should you participate in Acts of Compassion?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe the role of the church in helping the needy

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: describe the role of the church in helping the needy

Teach
• Today’s focus: describe the role of the church in helping the needy.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “describe the role of the church in helping the needy” using a school example.
• Model B for “describe the role of the church in helping the needy” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "describe the role of the church in helping the needy" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: describe the role of the church in helping the needy

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: describe the role of the church in helping the needy

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Acts of Compassion.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should you participate in Acts of Compassion?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• describe the role of the church in helping the needy
